name: Canadia Gateway for WooCommerce
author: canadiabankofficial

sections.description:
Designed to simplify merchant onboarding, the plugin provides a fast and standardized way to connect your WooCommerce store to Canadia Bank directly from your WordPress admin panel. Merchants can start accepting supported payment methods with minimal setup while benefiting from secure payment processing and automatic order synchronization.

Key Features

  • Official integration with Canadia Gateway
  • Simple configuration through WooCommerce settings
  • Support for KHQR payment across local banks
  • Secure hosted payment experience
  • Automatic payment callback and order status synchronization
  • Real-time payment status updates
  • Production environment support

Benefits

  • No custom API development required
  • Faster merchant onboarding and deployment
  • Standardized checkout and payment processing
  • Secure and reliable payment handling
  • Seamless integration with WooCommerce order management

Supported Payment Methods

  • KHQR Payment

Additional payment methods may be introduced in future releases.

Requirements

  • WordPress
  • WooCommerce
  • An active Canadia Gateway merchant account
  • Merchant API credentials provided by Canadia Bank

Support

For merchant onboarding, API credentials, or technical assistance, please contact the Canadia Gateway support team or your assigned Canadia Bank representative.
sections.installation:
1. Install and activate the Canadia Gateway for WooCommerce plugin.
  2. Navigate to WooCommerce → Settings → Payments.
  3. Enable Canadia Gateway.
  4. Enter your merchant credentials.
  5. Save your settings.
  6. Your store is ready to accept payments through Canadia Bank.
sections.faq:
What payment methods are supported?

Canadia Gateway currently supports the following payment methods:
* KHQR Payment

Additional payment methods may be introduced in future releases.

Which currencies are supported?

Canadia Gateway currently supports transactions in:
* Cambodian Riel (KHR)
* US Dollar (USD)

How do I obtain the credentials?

Submit an access request to the Canadia Bank team. Once approved, you will receive:
* Merchant ID
* API Credentials
* API Endpoint
* Access Instructions

Is payment information secure?

Yes. Canadia Gateway uses industry-standard encryption and secure communication protocols to protect payment information and ensure every transaction is processed securely.
